Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. findings.problem: After the privacy banner was dismissed, an unnamed dialog (Close, empty level-1 heading, Continue) stayed in the tree; its Close button could not take keyboard focus and it was never explained.

A newsletter popup (Dont miss a step) opened on its own with focus pulled into it after the page loaded, with a 10 percent discount offer; the page body looked empty for a moment before it appeared, and I had to read twice to find the popup.

In the Added to your bag dialog the bag showed 0 items and Checkout was disabled at first, and nothing announced when it changed to 1 item; I only learned by re-reading. The Checkout button then said Action in progress with no clear announcement of the page change.
Colour options are plain links with no indication which is current, and the Added to your bag dialog has an empty list item and an unlabelled extra dialog with an unnamed button.
